title: Native Geometry vs. Linear Recoverability: How Alignment Changes Platonic Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.22749v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Do larger models learn increasingly similar representations of the same world? The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) predicts that they should, but similar can mean native cosine geometry---nearest-neighbour structure induced by cosine similarity before any learned alignment---or linear recoverability: correspondence revealed by a supervised linear map. Using matched Legacy Survey and Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) embeddings across five model families, we find that Ridge alignment strengthens the relationship between model size and cross-dataset neighbourhood correspondence relative to native cosine geometry. The effect appears in all five families and persists when both representations are reduced to dimension, so it is not simply that wider embeddings give alignment more dimensions to work with. translated_title: 原生几何与线性可恢复性：对齐如何改变柏拉图式缩放
translated_abstract: 更大的模型是否会对同一个世界学习到越来越相似的表示？柏拉图表示假说（PRH）预测它们应当如此，但“相似”可以指原生余弦几何——即在 any 学习到的对齐之前，由余弦相似性诱导的最近邻结构——也可以指线性可恢复性：由监督线性映射所揭示的对应关系。通过在五个模型家族中使用匹配的Legacy Survey与Hyper Suprime-Cam（HSC）嵌入，我们发现相对于原生余弦几何，Ridge对齐增强了模型规模与跨数据集邻域对应性之间的关系。该效应在所有五个家族中均出现，并且在将两种表示都降维到相同维度后依然存在，因此这并非仅仅因为更宽的嵌入为对齐提供了更多可用维度。学习到的映射远非旋转或均匀缩放，且稀疏自编码器（SAE）与块稀疏特征化器（BSF）特征给出……
tldr: 本研究通过对五个模型家族的天文图像嵌入进行对比，发现监督式Ridge线性对齐能够显著增强模型规模与跨数据集表示对应性之间的关系，且该效应并非源于嵌入维度优势或简单的旋转缩放变换，表明柏拉图式表示收敛主要通过监督对齐而非原生余弦几何体现。
en_tdlr: Using matched astronomical image embeddings across five model families, this study shows that supervised Ridge linear alignment substantially strengthens the relationship between model scale and cross-dataset representational correspondence—beyond native cosine geometry, dimension effects, or simple rotations—indicating that Platonic convergence emerges through learned alignment rather than native geometry.
